answer: The bedrock check is proof of unique farrier shoeing record with farriers council attestation. Under it sits the farrier's signed record, and no template can dig around it. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 529 fakes need 529, at 101 POA each, totalling 53429 POA. The jetty tells you who issued it, the ferrous tells you what it cost, and the ledge tells you when it was earned. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
